notes.title: Release Date
notes.notes:
Hey there guys! Yesterday I announced the release date for Knight And Mourning! It releases on the 11th of April, 2023! Thanks for following this game, I can't wait for you guys to play it! I'm mainly testing out the posting tool for steam, so bear with me if it's boring!

Here's the trailer announcing the release date!

[previewyoutube=4l-gwuEBlj0;full][/previewyoutube]

Thanks for your time!
